answer_first.execution_question: What training objective does CLIP use to align images and text?
answer_first.direct_answer: CLIP aligns images and text with a contrastive objective: given a batch of N (image, text) pairs, it jointly trains an image encoder and a text encoder to predict which of the N × N possible pairings actually occurred. Concretely, it learns a multi-modal embedding space by maximizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings of the N real (matched) pairs in the batch while minimizing the cosine similarity of the N²−N incorrect pairings, optimizing a symmetric cross-entropy loss over these similarity scores. The CLIP paper notes this batch-construction technique/objective corresponds to the multi-class N-pair loss (Sohn 2016), popularized as the InfoNCE contrastive loss (Oord et al. 2018).

# 对用户问题的回答

CLIP 使用什么训练目标来对齐图像和文本？

## 直接回答

CLIP 使用对比目标来对齐图像和文本：给定一批 N 个（图像，文本）对，它联合训练一个图像编码器和一个文本编码器，以预测 N × N 种可能配对中实际发生的是哪一种。具体而言，它通过最大化批次中 N 个真实（匹配）对的嵌入的余弦相似度，同时最小化 N²−N 个错误配对的嵌入的余弦相似度，来学习一个多模态嵌入空间，并针对这些相似度分数优化对称交叉熵损失。CLIP 论文指出，这种批次构建技术/目标对应于多类 N 对损失（Sohn 2016），并作为 InfoNCE 对比损失（Oord et al. 2018）而广为人知。
